articles.title: Bitcoin bounces 9% from two-year low to retake $60,000 as traders eye Monday’s stock open
articles.description: The sell-off wiped out $1.8 billion in leveraged crypto positions, mostly from bullish bets on rising prices.

articles.title: Cross-chain protocol Chainflip's FLIP tanks 30% after suspected $4.86 million vault drain
articles.description: The withdrawal carried a valid signature, which Onchain Lens said points to a possible compromise of the key validators use to approve vault payouts.

articles.title: Ether treasury firm BTCS warns SEC its $54 million Aave loan could be liquidated
articles.description: BTCS cut its reported Aave debt by about $10 million in ten days, but falling ether prices are keeping its collateral under pressure.

articles.title: Bitcoin nodes could be stalled by repeating one ID 50,000 times. AI found the bug
articles.description: Bitcoin Core shipped fixes on Friday for a bug flagged by Loupe, an open-source scanner from Block’s Spiral that uses AI agents to examine bitcoin code.

articles.title: XRP falls 10% as long bets unwind and ETF assets slip below $1 billion
articles.description: The token broke its previous November lows during Saturday's crypto selloff, with long positions accounting for most XRP liquidations and technical indicators showing further weakness.

articles.title: Kalshi races to get ahead of New York order that could shut down exchange
articles.description: The U.S. prediction market firm asked a New York court to give the company a chance to argue against a pending restraining order stemming from a new court loss.

articles.title: Fairmint plans tokenized stock venue on Canton, Ethereum under SEC experiment
articles.description: The firm is the latest to join in building blockchain-based stock markets under the agency’s five-year "innovation exemption" for tokenized trading.

articles.title: Bitcoin plunges below $59,000 as rush to cash puts new bear market lows back in play
articles.description: Bitcoin is closing in on its $57,700 summer low as Delphi Digital strategist warns the Fed could make matters worse and STS Digital sees cash as the place to hide.

articles.title: Former Point72 head of proprietary research says AI could turn data into a new asset class for Wall Street

articles.title: Hong Kong moves to extend crypto licensing rules to brokers, advisers and custodians
articles.description: Hong Kong wants to bring crypto brokers, advisers, asset managers and custodians under its existing regulatory framework.

articles.title: U.S. Senate passes bill to ban prediction market bets on war and death
articles.description: The bill would ban bets on war, assassinations and military operations amid concerns that traders could profit from inside information, as has already occurred.

articles.title: Live news: Bitcoin slips to fresh lows below $59,000 as Anthropic slides after Nasdaq debut
articles.description: BlackRock’s bitcoin ETF saw a record $541.1 million outflow as the U.S. tech selloff spread to Asia, sending South Korea’s Kospi down more than 5%.

articles.title: Bitcoin bots pounced within seconds when researchers exposed their wallet keys
articles.description: University of Liège researchers put a few dollars into deliberately vulnerable bitcoin addresses and watched rival bots race for the money within seconds.

articles.title: ECB’s Lagarde warns Europe could lose control of growing tokenized asset market

articles.title: No special rules for Hyperliquid or other onchain trading platforms, CFTC says
articles.description: Hyperliquid and other onchain exchanges can offer derivatives to U.S. traders if they obtain the required licenses or work with a registered exchange, the CFTC chairman said.

articles.title: This Bitcoin miner sold 267 BTC to clear $22 million debt. It still may not survive
articles.description: PowerCompute had its lender sell 267 pledged bitcoin in September, wiping out most of its debt, and ended the month with about $650,000 in cash and a going-concern warning.

articles.title: Big money bought a net $4 billion of bitcoin funds in Q3, ending 9 months of selling
articles.description: Wall Street piled into Bitcoin funds in the third quarter, ending a three-quarter selling streak, according to Galaxy Research. But the buying has given way to renewed selling this quarter.
